source.authors: Per Alexandersson and Frether Getachew Kebede
source.title: An involution on derangements preserving excedances and right-to-left minima
source.wording_history: v1=v2: malformed (k unused, sum over all S_n, sign (-1)^n(-1)^len(type), y_{sigma(j)}); v3 and MathDB: 1<=k<=n, no sign; VoR: 2<=k<=n with (-1)^(n-1), remark 'not true for k = 1'

A_statement_fidelity.summary: Definitions and Conjecture 5.2.1 quoted from VoR and all arXiv versions. MathDB copies v3 wording, which is trivially false at (2,1) and at every even n with k=2 (sign); the substantive target is the VoR statement. The family also refutes the MathDB wording non-degenerately at odd n (n=9, k=3, raw coefficient -1). Source prints no F_{n,k} for k>=3 and claims no verification range; its only data (A124302 counts, printed single-cycle polynomial, S_7 table) agree with my computations; the printed 'n = 3' polynomial is a typo for n = 4.
A_statement_fidelity.qualification: Root must accept scoring against the VoR (intended) statement; recommend endpoint refuting both readings at (9,3). Dossier mis-describes v1/v2 wording (minor).

B_independent_math.summary: Own code: full S_n for n=2..10. VoR holds for all 2<=k<=n when n<=7. n=8: F_{8,3} has 256 positive, 2 negative coefficients incl. x_{1,4,6,7} y_{2,3,5,8} = -1. n=9: 707 positive, 15 negative, target x_{1,5,7,8} y_{2,3,4,6,9} = -1 (raw = normalised). n=10: k=3 89 negative; k=4 also fails (3 negative). Exact definition-only DFS, n=8..16: exactly 8 permutations each, symbolic tails and cycle types identical to dossier table, F_{n,3} coefficient -1. Hand re-derivation of P1, P2, steps 1-3, 8-case split and cycle types: no gap; n=7 boundary gives 0 as expected.

C_prior_art.summary: OpenAlex: 2 citers of arXiv record (Pei-Zeng AAM 2023; Beyene-Mantaci arXiv 2021), 1 citer of Pei-Zeng (Ji-Zhang EJC 2024), 28 Alexandersson works since 2021-06: none addresses the cycle-length conjecture. Pei-Zeng TeX line 283 mentions only the d_{n,k} open problems. No erratum; arXiv v3 latest. GitHub repo search: 5 topical queries 0 hits, positive control 228 hits, no 403. Lean Pool HEAD 01db1d70 (LeanPool/projects.yml, candidates/discovered.yml, candidates/decisions.jsonl): no hit. Live MathDB: open, 0 solutions, 0 Lean formalisations.
C_prior_art.qualification: Bounded: Crossref, Semantic Scholar, arXiv search API, ScienceDirect denied; OpenAlex does not index the VoR separately.

D_significance_exclusion.summary: Not known, not a corollary, not a source-formula evaluation, not contradicted by source data, not withdrawn (VoR statement re-affirmed through three revisions), not a wording/endpoint correction (k=3 is the first case beyond the k=2 theorem, interior of the corrected domain), not publicly refuted. Matches qualifying small-exact-counterexample precedents. k=4 also fails at n=10, so the failure is not isolated.
D_significance_exclusion.qualification: Moderate significance: conjecture in a 'Further ideas' section; result is a refutation; a residual k>=5 question remains open.

E_lean_route.summary: Draft definitions excv, rlmv, variable encoding and minCycleGe are faithful; draft proof is a skeleton (monoX8, coeff_AKsum_8_3 undefined; smul_coeff_eq not a Mathlib name; correct lemma MvPolynomial.coeff_smul). Required changes: literal invCount with (-1)^invCount instead of Perm.sign (removes the bridge); literal N-membership via exists p : MvPolynomial _ N with map (Nat.castRingHom Z) p = ...; prefer Equiv.Perm.partition for min(type). Recommended endpoint: not VoRConj and not MathDBConj, both witnessed at (9,3), monomial x_{1,5,7,8} y_{2,3,4,6,9}. Estimated 300-600 lines; avoid whole-S_n kernel decide; no native_decide; axioms only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

conditions: Root explicitly scopes MathDB 350721 to the VoR Conjecture 5.2.1 (the MathDB/v3 wording is trivially false and alone would be zero-credit).

The Lean endpoint should refute both the VoR statement and the MathDB wording (single witness at n=9, k=3), use literal inversions and literal N-membership, and be compiled with a strict axiom audit by a Lean-enabled worker.
